subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Find specific information in an email about a school trip to Bahla.
Answer questions in complete sentences and decide True, False or Doesn't say.
Know the parts of an email: To, Subject, Dear …, Yours.

tf.s: An express coach is a fast coach.
Students should arrive at school after the coach leaves.
tf.why: They arrive at 4 p.m., before the coach leaves at 4.30.

tf.s: The trip lasts three days: Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.
tf.why: Yes, that is the trip timeline.

tf.s: The Subject box tells the reader the topic of the email.
tf.why: Yes, the subject shows what it is about.

tf.s: Lovely and wonderful describe nice things.
Students need a raincoat because it often rains in Bahla.
The famous fort is in Bahla.
tf.why: Yes, Bahla fort is a UNESCO site.

tf.s: Busy means having nothing to do.
tf.why: Busy means having a lot to do.

tf.s: The email tells students what to bring on the trip.
tf.why: Yes, it lists things to bring.

tf.s: Students don't need any money on the trip.
tf.why: They need money for lunch on Monday.

boxes.q: On which day does the trip start?
What do students need money for on Monday?
Why should students bring a sunhat?
boxes.why: A sunhat protects you from the sun.

boxes.q: Which part of an email starts the message?
Where do you write the email address?
boxes.why: The To box has the address.

boxes.q: What does express mean in express coach?
boxes.why: An express coach is fast with few stops.

boxes.q: Bahla fort is a UNESCO World ___ site.
boxes.why: It is a World Heritage site.
Lucky = good things happen to you.

boxes.q: Which day comes after Sunday in the trip timeline?
boxes.why: The trip goes Sunday, Monday, Tuesday.

hunt.q: Shoes for a lot of walking
Answer when the text has no info

mcq.q: What are the main parts of an email?
mcq.why: These are the parts of an email.

mcq.q: What can students do at the hotel?
mcq.why: That is why they need a swimsuit.
Bahla fort is a UNESCO site.

mcq.q: When should you use a dictionary while reading?
mcq.why: Guess from context first, then check key words.

mcq.q: Answer in a complete sentence: When is the trip?
o: The trip is next Sunday, 16th April.
mcq.why: A complete sentence has a subject and a verb.

mcq.q: Answer in a complete sentence: What can you see from the walls at the top of the fort?
o: You can see some wonderful views from the walls at the top.
mcq.why: Repeat the key words of the question.

mcq.q: You are going to Bahla. It is usually hot. What is a good thing to take?
mcq.why: Water keeps you healthy in hot weather.

mcq.q: True, False or Doesn't say? The students will buy gifts in the souq.
mcq.why: The email only says they can bring money for a gift if they want.

mcq.q: Why must students wear trainers or comfortable shoes?
o: They are going to do a lot of walking.
Shoes are not allowed at the fort.
mcq.why: Comfortable shoes help on long walks.

mcq.q: Why is the weather information in the email important?
o: So students bring a sunhat and light clothes.
So students can buy a raincoat.
So the coach can leave early.
mcq.why: It helps students pack the right things.
